description_sq:
Bazzar Gate – Porta e Re e Tiranës Moderne me 27 kate!
Me një dizajn bashkëkohor dhe elemente që reflektojnë identitetin kulturor të Tiranës, Bazzar Gate do të jetë një ndërthurje mes traditës dhe inovacionit e cila eshte 
Kulla Bazaar Gate është projektuar nga studio prestigjoze “Bolles + Wilson”, nominuar nga Archdaily 2023 për Ndërtimin e Vitit, e njohur ndërkombëtarisht për projektimin e ‘’Luxor Theatre’’ në Rotterdam, apo shumë projekte të suksesshme në Shqipëri!.
Informacione 
•Ne ndërtim / Faze Grope 
• Kati 12 Banim
• Sipërfaqe bruto 71.6m2
• Sipërfaqe neto 57.4m2
• Kubaturë e Rregullt
• Cmimi: 236280 Euro
Instalime mekanike dhe Hidraulike 
Rrjeti i kanalizemve eshte projektur me diameter 80 mm deri ne 250mm.i cili eshte i ndare nga ujerat e zeza.
Depot e uji te cilen do sherbejne ne shperndarjen e rrjetit te ujit per banoret dhe rrjeti per kundra zjarrit jane te vecuar nga njera tjetra qe ne kete menyre te funksionojne ne menyre te pavarur.
Kabina Elektrike do vendoset ne katin perdhe dhe fuqia e transformatorit do jete 630kVa ,e cila do sherbeje per te gjithe godinen.
Sistemet elektrike ofrojne paketa lidhese te lidhje te internetit nepet ambientet e brendshmet e cdo lloj furnitori dhe pjesa e lartesis se dhomave eshte sipas standarteve europiane.
Ne pjesen e furnizimit me energji elektrike qe eshte shume e rendesishme ,firma projektuese kane menduar edhe ne raste emergjente duke vendosur nje gjenerator e cila do vije ne ndihme per te bere te mundur aksesin dhe levizjen e banorve ne objekt.
Dicka qe eshte shume e rendesishme qe fuqia e pajisjve elektrike te intalur dhe te perdorura ne apartamente parashikohet qe te perdoret Pll=5KW.
Ne ambiente e dhomese gjumit do perdoret parketi laminat, ecila do perdoret duke ruajtur konturet e dhomes.
Dyet e jashtme jane te certifikuara,me izolim akustik dhe termike .
Godina do kete ne funksion 4 ashensore per katet e banimit ,te cilet do levizin me nje shpejtesi 1.6m/s ndersa per hotelin do jene vetem dy dhe do levizin me shpejtesi 2.5 m/s.
Muret ndarese do kete nje trashesi rreth 30 ncm dhe te cilat do jene te veshura me lesh guri.
Sistemi i fasades do jete i gjithi i ventiluar.
Te gjitha keto informacione jane te bashkangjitura ne kontraten e blerjes.

description_en: Bazzar Gate – New Gate of Modern Tirana with 27 floors! With a contemporary design and elements that reflect the cultural identity of Tirana, Bazzar Gate will be a mix between tradition and innovation which is the Bazaar Gate Tower was designed by the prestigious studio "Bolles + Wilson", nominated by Archdaily 2023 for Building of the Year, internationally known for the design of the "Luxor Theater" in Rotterdam, or many successful projects in Albania!. Information • Under construction / Pit phase • 12th floor Residential • Gross area 71.6m2 • Net area 57.4m2 • Regular cubic capacity • Price: 236280 Euro Mechanical and hydraulic installations The sewer network is designed with a diameter of 80 mm to 250 mm, which is separated from the sewage. The water tanks that will serve in the distribution of the water network for the residents and the fire fighting network are separate from each other so that they can function independently. The electrical cabinet will be located on the ground floor and the power of the transformer will be 630kVa, which will serve the entire building. The electrical systems offer Internet connection packages for the interiors of any type of supplier and the height of the rooms is according to European standards. In the part of the electricity supply, which is very important, the design firms have thought even in emergency cases by placing a generator which will come to the rescue to enable the access and movement of the residents in the building. Something that is very important is that the power of the electrical equipment installed and used in the apartments is expected to use Pll=5KW. Laminate parquet will be used in the bedroom, each one will be used while maintaining the contours of the room. The two exteriors are certified, with acoustic and thermal insulation. The building will have 4 elevators in operation for the residential floors, which will move at a speed of 1.6 m/s, while for the hotel there will be only two and they will move at a speed of 2.5 m/s. The partition walls will have a thickness of about 30 ncm and will be covered with stone wool. The facade system will be all ventilated. All this information is attached to the purchase contract.
